'''Brobius''' was a quiet [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] steward for [[Omze'kehr Kahr]]. They rented cabins to [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] traveling on ''[[Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport/Legends|Omze's Incredible Traveling Starport]]''.
